scripts-descriptions.docs:generate: Regenerates public/docs/openapi.yaml from the OA attributes in the controllers
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: The unit tests alone — no database, fractions of a second
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: The integration tests — they build a separate <DB>_test database
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: The tests with an HTML coverage report in coverage/
scripts-descriptions.test:schema: Regenerates tests/fixtures/schema.sql from the development database
scripts-descriptions.migrate:status: Which migrations are applied and which are pending
scripts-descriptions.migrate:baseline: Record the existing migrations as applied without running them (first setup)
scripts-descriptions.analyse: PHPStan — static analysis looking for logic errors
scripts-descriptions.lint:js: ESLint over public/js — zero warnings tolerated, as in CI
scripts-descriptions.lint:css: Stylelint over public/css — the same command CI runs
scripts-descriptions.test:js: Vitest — the front-end tests, run in jsdom over the public/js files themselves
scripts-descriptions.smoke: A smoke test: it requests every GET route and checks the response is sound
scripts-descriptions.audit:code: A measurement report on the state of the code — lines, duplication and the longest functions
scripts-descriptions.audit:escaping: Classifies every <?= ?> in the views by its need for escaping
scripts-descriptions.audit:imports: Reveals classes used with neither an import nor a qualification
scripts-descriptions.images:webp: Generates the WebP copies of the product images (<picture> depends on them)
scripts-descriptions.check: The full gate: validate + analyse + lint (PHP, JS and CSS) + escaping-gate + readme-check + test (PHPUnit and Vitest) — run it before any push
scripts-descriptions.fix:blocked-orders: A one-time data repair: it cancels the pending orders of blocked users from before auto-cancel was switched on
scripts-descriptions.audit:escaping:gate: The escaping gate: it fails if new unescaped output appears in the views
scripts-descriptions.readme:sync: Measures the project's numbers from the code and writes them into the README
scripts-descriptions.readme:check: The README gate: it fails if its numbers drift from the code
